The entire correct source pose remains fixed; only tiny natural facial nuance can follow the literary mood below. Preserve exactly what is actually held, closed/on the seat, or absent; no new book for empty hands. A desk source keeps its original occupied wooden chair and accepted local chair rotation, forearm/desk contact and existing plant occlusion; the empty plate does not reset the chair behind the person. A bench source keeps both complete visible shoes, hands and actual knee/shin relationship. No crossed-one-knee/two-parallel-flat-feet ambiguity, fused limbs/fingers, extra hand, furniture penetration or floating object.

Room invariant: preserve the complete wooden window and same lake-town/mountain/trees, original curtains, LEFT desk/chair/shelves/books/frames/plants, ROUND table with porcelain lamp/cup/flowers/books, linen bench, blue-gray plaid pillows/knitted throw, wood floor/rug/foreground plant. 心理：她先替最想去、最想做的那一边说话，随后看见现实条件并不肯让步。她想保住期待，也肯承认代价。 兴致并非鲁莽；她不愿让喜欢的事在一张整齐安排里悄悄消失。 夜里不急着给明天写一个漂亮答案，她先算清喜欢的事要付出什么。
神情：轻轻皱眉，偶有想出新办法的小亮意。 安静、有主见，笑意只在真正找到办法时出现。
相处：把可改的两种过法放出来，听到对方更在意别的也能转向。 把自己偏爱的方案也当作可修改草稿。

Repaint all skin/hair/white clothing/paper/limbs and floor/contact reception in this same local warm lamp plus cool dim window light. Remove residual daytime sun-facing hot rim/grid; any warm hair edge must belong to plausible existing-lamp/bounce light, not sunlight. Keep shoes and hands readable without a spotlight or glowing contour. Rain is weather, not automatic sadness, tears or a new story.
Every material shares this environment: character skin/hair/uniform/eyes, held paper/book/pen, linen/wood, the chair/bench supports, shoes and adjacent floor. Keep original uniform local colors and youthful anime identity; white collars/pages receive the real ambient exposure rather than glowing daylight-white. No simple color filter, sunny cutout pasted on a dark background, half-day/half-night seam, gray/gold wash, arbitrary neon or new spotlight.

Preserve refined youthful 2D anime linework and soft modeled shading naturally integrated with the detailed literary-room illustration. Entire frame, true source scale and support, no second person/extra limb, no UI, labels, icons, logo, watermark, collage, border, fog or new props.
